svg.title: Cloned the missing app's repository versus finished the change
svg.desc: Grouped bar chart, one panel per condition. For each ticket, the number of multi-repo runs of the policy change that cloned the missing app's repository and the number that finished with every app updated. Open-ended tickets and the three fixes clone it and finish in every run. Partial-list tickets often finish less than they clone: in the 17-repository estate, 4 of 5 partial-list runs cloned it and none finished.
